divergences.old: jwt decode - failing with "Invalid JWT: expected 3 dot-separated parts"
divergences.toil: - reads the token from stdin on the CLI, dropping one trailing line ending (echo $TOKEN | toil util jwt decode -), so the token stays out of the process list and shell history. Over MCP, - is INVALID_INPUT, since stdin is the protocol there
divergences.why: A JWT is a credential, and argv is visible to every process on the machine; stdin is how toil takes one.
